notes: Cross-sectional mixed-methods survey of 384 refugee smallholder crop farmers in Nakivale settlement, Uganda (plus 12 KIIs). Adoption self-reported; no adoption definition and no survey year given. Only 'agroforestry' maps to a defined practice (trees_in_farmlands, undefined in the paper, so it may include boundary or other tree plantings). Crop diversification, conservation tillage (tillage only, no residue: not ca_bundle), drought-resistant crops (out_of_scope) and water harvesting (out_of_scope) not extracted. Overall CSA adoption (79%, n = 304), motivations, barriers among non-adopters (Table 5 and text p.5) and attitude predictors (Table 3) refer to CSA in general, not to agroforestry, so they have no single practice code and were not extracted. Table 4 is internally inconsistent (see row notes).
